item.text: *Trifolium phleoides* Pourr. ex Willd. is a flowering plant species in the legume family Fabaceae, first published in 1802. Its subspecies *T. phleoides* subsp. *willkommii* is native to mainland Portugal and is not protected under Portuguese or European Community legislation. [s1:p1–p4]
